title: Form completion #1
topic: Coach tour booking · Hotel booking · Gym membership · Lost property report
context:
Narrator: Conversation 1. Coach tour booking.
Grace: Highland Day Tours, Grace speaking.
Caller: Hi, I'd like to book a place on the castle tour.
Grace: And what's the best number to reach you on?
Caller: It's oh seven oh, two nine oh three, eight seven one two.
Grace: How many people will be coming?
Caller: Eight, I think.
Grace: What's your postcode?
Caller: G F eight, nine P Z.
Grace: Which date would you like to travel?
Caller: The twelfth of July... no, sorry, that's a Sunday. Make it the eleventh of July.
Caller: How much is the price per person?
Grace: It's fifty-five pounds.
Grace: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
Narrator: Conversation 2. Hotel booking.
Daniel: Good afternoon, Lakeside Hotel, Daniel speaking.
Caller: Hello, I'd like to book a room, please.
Daniel: What date would you like to arrive?
Caller: The seventh of May, please.
Caller: How much is the deposit?
Daniel: It's twenty pounds... oh, hold on, that's last year's price. This year it's thirty pounds.
Daniel: And what's the best number to reach you on?
Caller: It's oh seven nine, three three three oh, seven nine two two.
Daniel: Can I take your surname, please?
Caller: It's Yardley. That's Y, A, R, D, L, E, Y.
Daniel: What's your postcode?
Caller: G C six, nine J H.
Daniel: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
Narrator: Conversation 3. Gym membership.
Sam: Good morning, Riverside Fitness, Sam speaking.
Caller: Hello, I'd like to join the gym, please.
Sam: How many classes a week do you think you will come to?
Caller: Three, I think. Actually, let me say two, it's better to be safe.
Sam: When would you like to start?
Caller: The twenty-first of June, please.
Sam: Let me give you your reference. Have you got a pen?
Caller: Yes, go ahead.
Sam: It's P M nine five zero three.
Caller: How much is the joining fee?
Sam: It's fifteen pounds.
Sam: And what's the best number to reach you on?
Caller: It's oh seven five, nine four oh two, seven four nine seven.
Sam: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
Narrator: Conversation 4. Lost property report.
Mark: Central Station lost property, Mark speaking.
Caller: Hello, I think I left my rucksack on a train yesterday.
Mark: Let me give you your reference. Have you got a pen?
Caller: Yes, go ahead.
Mark: It's Q H seven eight five seven.
Mark: What's your postcode?
Caller: M K six, seven L N.
Mark: On which date did you lose it?
Caller: The second of December... no, sorry, that's a Sunday. Make it the first of December.
Mark: How many items were in the bag?
Caller: Seven, I think.
Mark: Can I take your surname, please?
Caller: It's Pemberton. That's P, E, M, B, E, R, T, O, N.
Mark: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
